title: 5.3.36 Challenges
description: Pick one (or more) OOP stretch challenges — extend your Enemy class, write a Player class, or try subclassing with `extends`. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Define a class
steps.instructions: Declare at least one class using the `class` keyword.
hints: Re-read 2.2.3 Reading for the `class Name { ... }` shape.

steps.title: Instantiate the class
steps.instructions: Build an instance with `new ClassName(...)` and store it in a variable.
hints: 2.2.4 Worked Example shows `new Sprite(...)` — the same pattern applies to your own class.

steps.title: Write a constructor
steps.instructions: Give the class a `constructor(...)` that stores its arguments on `this`.
hints: 2.2.3 Reading walks through the three parts of a class: constructor, `this`, and methods.

steps.title: Use one OOP feature
steps.instructions: Pick a challenge from content.md and implement it using at least one of: `this.<property>` access, `extends` another class, or a `super(...)` call.
hints: content.md lists three challenges with hints for each. Pick whichever interests you — the auto-grader accepts `this.`, `extends`, or `super(`.

requirements.title: Define at least one class
requirements.description: script.js contains at least one class definition.

requirements.title: Instantiates a class of your own
requirements.description: Builds an object from a class the student defined — new Canvas() and new Sprite() are boilerplate and do not count

requirements.title: Write a constructor
requirements.description: At least one class has a constructor method.

requirements.title: Use one OOP feature
requirements.description: Your class uses at least one of: `this.<property>`, `extends`, or `super(`.
